PRIMALPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}primal peas occasionally knock zombies back

{FLAVOR}Primal Peashooter may be primitive, but that doesn't stop him from enrolling and excelling in several software development correspondence courses.
PRIMALPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Primal Peashooters shoot heavy peas with a brief stun at zombies.
PRIMALPOTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, delayed activation, explodes on contact

{FLAVOR}Primal Potato Mine doesn't consider himself to be primal. As far as he's concerned he's state-of-the-art. And who knows? Maybe he is.
PRIMALPOTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Primal Potato Mines cost more than regular Potato Mines but do damage over a larger area.
PRIMALSUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Primal Sunflower is new to all this sun-giving business, so be patient with her. She's an early adopter of the all-you-can-stuff-yourself buffet style of sun production.
PRIMALSUNFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Primal Sunflowers pop out large suns instead of regular ones.
PRIMALWALLNUT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}withstands instant kills, only takes 1500 damage

{FLAVOR}"Grunt," explains Primal Wall-nut. "Grunt oog grunt-grunt," he goes on to say. "Ook-urg grunty grunt grunt," he concludes. A nut of many opinions, is Primal Wall-nut.
PRIMALWALLNUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Primal Wall-nuts cost a bit more than typical Wall-nuts, but they can be planted much more quickly.
PRIMALWALLNUT_TOOLTIP: Quick-planting wall that blocks off zombies

PUFFBALL_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}"You think cuz I'm Puffball that I'm puffy, that I'm soft, that I'm insubstantial?" fumes Puffball. "You need to change that thinking. PRONTO."
PUFFBALL_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Puffballs explode when planted, poisoning zombies and briefly stuns in the three columns around them.
PUFFBALL_TOOLTIP: Stuns and poisons zombies across three columns
PUFFSHROOM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}lives for a limited time

{FLAVOR}Puff-shroom is hip to all the latest social networks. He loves to surf Sporebook, FungusedIn and ShroomstaGram. But sometimes he misses the simple camaraderie of a good ol' fashioned Lawn Area Network party.
PUFFSHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Puff-shrooms are short-range shooters that last for a limited time.
PUFFSHROOM_TOOLTIP: Short-range shooter, lasts for a limited time
PUMPKIN_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Pumpkin may be a hollowed-out shell, but he still has a rich inner life filled with feelings, fantasies and surprisingly disappointing opinions.
PUMPKIN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Pumpkins can be planted on top of other plants to provide a tough additional layer of armor.
PUMPKIN_TOOLTIP: Protects plants on which it is planted

PVINE_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}You may think there isn't much to Pea Vine, but if you sat down with him over a nice cup of warm milk, you'd learn that he's basically just a vine that shoots peas. Who knew?
PVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Pea Vines are vine plants that shoot peas and provide a slight amount of protection to plants underneath them.
PVINE_TOOLTIP: Protects a plant inside and shoot peas

PYREVINE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms the plant he's planted on
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}can still be frozen

{FLAVOR}Has considered other fire related works before; cooking, romantic lighting, babysitting, you name it. None of those jobs lasted more than a day, and they just don't suit him. Also they don't provide good health insurance.
PYREVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Pyre Vines can be planted on top of other plants to provide minor protection from cold plus an additional close range explosive attack.
PYREVINE_PLANTFOOD: Throws a line of flame down five tiles, damaging all zombies in it.
PYREVINE_TOOLTIP: Warms a plant inside and shoots at nearby zombies

REDSTINGER_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Flexibility is of key importance to Red Stinger. "I do stretching exercises every morning," he says. "It's important to stay mentally and physically nimble."
REDSTINGER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Red Stingers fire shots at full force when close to home and become more defensive the further from it they get.
REDSTINGER_TOOLTIP: Fires shots at full force when close to home and becomes more defensive further from it.

{FLAVOR}Reinforce-mint isn't scowling. He's just workshopping defense strategies, doing what he can to support the team. Maybe he's scowling a little bit. Fine.
REINFORCEMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Reinforce-mints push all zombies back and provide a temporary boost to all Reinforce-mint Family plants on the lawn.
REPEATER_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}"Everyone always asks me if we've met before," says Repeater. "Everyone always asks me if we've met before. Wait, did I just say that?"
REPEATER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Repeaters fire two peas at one time.
REPEATER_PLANTFOOD: Fires a stream of peas followed by a giant pea that does huge damage to one target.
REPEATER_TOOLTIP: Shoots two peas at the enemy
RESISTANCES_TOOLTIP_BODY: Plants from different families can be STRONG, WEAK or INEFFECTIVE against zombies.

RIFT_ZOMBOSS_OVER_DESCRIPTION: Time ran out and Zomboss has escaped! He left this behind...
SAPFLING_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Damage Details: {STAT}does no damage on impact, but creates sap puddle
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}slows zombies who walk in puddle

{FLAVOR}You've gotta see Sap-fling's throwing arm to believe it. He may be young, but everyone agrees ... the kid's got TALENT. Scouts from some of the biggest Pinecone Ball teams have been keeping a close eye on him. He could be headed to the majors. Oh sure, some knock him for his incredibly sticky spitball. But he only uses all-natural sap, so it's entirely legal.
SAPFLING_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Sap-flings create zombie-slowing puddles of sap.
SAUCER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, activates on contact
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}instantly abducts imps and shrunken zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}After the recent appearance of Saucer Squash, the ZIA continues to maintain its stance that there is no such thing as alien plant life, and that the Saucer Squash must be some kind of drone plot by rogue ants. While many zombies are still convinced by this coverup, the sights many Cowboy and Harvest Zombies see at night paint a truly horrifying story. Too bad that's never getting into Miss Information's news cast.
SAUCER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Saucer Squash stuns zombies in her beam, able to abduct low-health and shrunken zombies.
SECURITY_GOURD_DIALOG_BODY: Your brains are in danger! Hire a Security Gourd and push back the zombies!
